job.value: check the status of their purchases and open one

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'My purchases' with the 'To Pay / In progress / Completed / Returns / Cancelled' tabs makes the screen's purpose clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: Order cards lead with a status line ('Preparing your order >', 'Pending confirmation >') but the only visible affordance is that small chevron, so it isn't obvious the whole card opens the order.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Tab labels and status lines say what each shows.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Carousell Official Delivery', 'Meet-up' and 'Total' are terms a buyer already knows.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The screen asks for no decision beyond which tab or order to open.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Each card shows the full 'Order ID 33f1f9d5-3dc8-4de5-a99e-df11274beae8' up front, a reference number a buyer rarely needs on the list.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything is about the buyer's own orders at the post-payment stage.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Status, item title, delivery method and total carry the card; no explanatory text to read.
